decisions.rationale: The passage lists Method M’s p-values for all four named benchmarks; each is below 0.001 and is interpreted as membership evidence.
It correctly reports lower full-method p-values, but omits the contrasting across-benchmark significance patterns of the two ablations, an essential part of the mixed finding.
The complete benchmark-level p-values encode the reported significance pattern for PaCoST, both LLM DI variants, and Method M.
All four Method M p-values are explicitly listed, are below 0.001, and concern the intentionally contaminated benchmarks.
The passage reports full Method M outperforming both ablations, but omits their materially different significance patterns across the four benchmarks.
The complete ordered p-value comparisons across all benchmarks establish exactly which baseline variants crossed 0.05 and that Method M did so throughout.
The passage gives only a most-benchmarks significance summary; it neither states nor supplies enough baseline values to establish every method-by-benchmark comparison.
It correctly concludes that unseen data were not flagged in either setting; the misstated held-out minimum remains above 0.05 and does not change that finding.
It reports only the broad majority pattern and collapses the baselines, omitting the distinct PaCoST and two LLM DI significance patterns required by the finding.
The passage does not state universal lower p-values or provide sufficient PaCoST and LLM DI values to establish every comparison across all four benchmarks.
It identifies LLM DI-different’s two detections but understates entity-specific results, omitting PaCoST’s TriviaQA detection and LLM DI-same’s complete failure.
